Third pre-release of 2.3 — **see what you have read**.

## New

- **Reading state from KOReader** (read only, Bookbench never writes it back): status and progress, rating and highlights from each book's KOReader data, reading time, pages read and last read from KOReader's reading statistics.
- Library: new column *Read status* (unread, 53 %, finished, on hold), optional columns *Last read* and *Reading time* (right-click a column header), filters *Unread*, *Currently reading*, *Finished*, *On hold*. The status bar and the Metadata area show a short summary for the selected book.
- Folders on the e-reader show the current state on every reload. A library on your computer remembers the state each time its linked e-reader is connected; the library header says from when.
- Fix: after syncing, the status bar sometimes showed the reload message instead of the sync result.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.3-beta3.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
